text: Level three, question six: how many kilograms of tea at ninety rupees must be mixed with twelve kilograms at sixty to make a mixture worth seventy? Question seven: twenty litres of milk and water in the ratio three to one is mixed with thirty litres in the ratio four to one; find the percentage of milk. Question eight: twenty-six kilograms of rice at twenty rupees is mixed with thirty kilograms at thirty-six and sold at thirty rupees a kilogram; find the profit percent.
